prompts.label: A 分页式工作台
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop web application screenshot, landscape about 1586x992, front-on flat screen, not a poster, not a photo of a monitor. This is a Chinese merchant live-commerce SaaS Studio planning and local MOCK rehearsal page. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: inherit its navy #193c61 sidebar, cool white/light-gray workspace, teal #247965 main actions, system Arial/PingFang typography, thin #dde5ee borders, subtle 5px controls and 7px surfaces, flat no shadows. DO NOT copy order/payment/customer content or order layout. Fixed outer shell: 214px dark sidebar with brand 直播商家工作台, nav 商品, 库存, 订单, 直播工作区 (selected), 网站客服, Meta消息, 平台支持, 设置; 66px topbar store 演示店铺 on left, 简体中文 and 商家账号 on right. Core page title 直播工作室, visible small note 设计示例 · 仅本地模拟，不会公开直播. Exact useful content: selected synthetic session 秋季好物介绍; other sessions 周末上新 and 新品预告; form fields 场次名称, 计划时间（UTC）, 画幅; values 秋季好物介绍, 2026/09/30 12:00, 9:16; buttons 保存草稿 and 新建场次 each appear once. Clearly separate persisted programme 草稿 / 版本 1 from rehearsal and media observations. Include small text block 已准备模拟授权; destinations Facebook and Instagram each marked 公开状态未验证. Local demo ready state: no attempt yet, display 尚未开始 and button 开始模拟演练 once. Text note 不代表真实平台开播资格. No actual stream/video preview/camera, audience/revenue KPIs, recording, chat panels, product pinning, claims of real platform connection or fictional live success. Avoid a wall of repeated cards. All core Chinese labels legible, generous but purposeful spacing, realistic crisp UI, no browser chrome. Render one complete coherent first viewport. Composition A: a narrow full-width horizontal session selector below the heading, selected 秋季好物介绍, secondary 新建场次 at far right. Under this, two quiet tabs 节目设置 (active) and 模拟演练. Dominant central large white editor area in a single column, form width about 750px rather than many mini cards; save button immediately below form. A compact noninteractive summary strip beneath editor shows 模拟授权 已准备, 媒体状态 尚未开始, Facebook / Instagram 公开状态未验证. Explain in a short line 切换到模拟演练查看状态与控制. The primary simulator action belongs to the second tab, so DO NOT show active 开始模拟演练 button in this settings-tab screenshot; a small descriptive link 查看模拟演练 is fine. This deliberate mode separation is the signature, not a left list or table. No fake preview. One dominant editor with useful fields, no empty decorative expanse.
